items.name: Names its source page
items.accepts: A correction that names the exact page and PDF version.
items.rejects: A correction that names a different version of the PDF.

items.name: A second call reviews it
items.accepts: A review with its own response ID.
items.rejects: A review that has the same response ID as the correction.

items.name: Each printed cell keeps a record
items.accepts: Merged cells keep the values that the page shows.
items.rejects: A table that drops an empty cell from the count.

items.name: A heading stays in its scope
items.accepts: A local heading covers only its own rows and columns.
items.rejects: A local heading that reaches later rows.

items.name: Save whole documents only
items.accepts: A document where every page passes review.
items.rejects: A document with one page that failed review.

items.name: One failure, others continue
items.accepts: The queue moves on after a held document.
items.rejects: A batch that stops at the first failure.
